note: Synthetic project cards for the Engramkeep demo store. No real project names, people, or secrets.

cards.title: Atlas API
cards.body:
# Atlas API

Synthetic service notes for the Engramkeep demo store.

## Decisions

- Use FastAPI with Pydantic v2 models at the HTTP boundary.
- Store money as integer cents in PostgreSQL; never use floats.
- Keep authentication in one `auth` module; sessions are opaque tokens in a `sessions` table.
- Run Alembic migrations in CI before deploying.

## Gotchas

- PostgreSQL `password authentication failed` during local setup usually means the role does not exist yet, not that the password is wrong.
- `psycopg2` needs a binary wheel on Windows; prefer `psycopg[binary]` in development.
- Connections leak when a request raises before the dependency closes; keep the session in a context manager.

## Next steps

- Add request-id logging.
- Benchmark the `/search` endpoint with 10k rows.

cards.title: Orbit Mobile
cards.body:
# Orbit Mobile

Synthetic Capacitor app notes for the Engramkeep demo store.

## Decisions

- Ship a Capacitor hybrid app instead of two native codebases.
- Queue writes in SQLite and sync when the device is online; never block the UI on the network.
- Keep the Android keystore outside the repository and load secrets from CI variables.
- Pin the Gradle wrapper and use JDK 17 for every build.

## Gotchas

- A keystore error is usually a wrong alias or a stale password, not a corrupted file.
- SQLite writes from two isolates cause `database is locked`; keep one writer.
- Offline timestamps must be stored in UTC and reconciled on the server.

## Next steps

- Add a background sync retry with exponential backoff.
- Test the upgrade path from the previous app version.

cards.title: Ledger CLI
cards.body:
# Ledger CLI

Synthetic command-line bookkeeping tool for the Engramkeep demo store.

## Decisions

- Keep the package dependency-free at runtime.
- Represent amounts with `decimal.Decimal`, never binary floats.
- Publish wheels through GitHub Actions and verify them with `twine check`.
- Keep the CLI deterministic: no network access, no background jobs.

## Gotchas

- `pip install` from a source checkout can pick up a stale build directory; use an isolated virtual environment.
- Editable installs hide missing package data; test the built wheel in a clean environment.
- CI tokens need explicit `permissions:` when the default token is read-only.

## Next steps

- Add import from CSV with a dry-run preview.
- Document the exit codes.

cards.title: Signal Dashboard
cards.body:
# Signal Dashboard

Synthetic React dashboard for the Engramkeep demo store.

## Decisions

- Use React with TypeScript and Vite for the build.
- Keep chart colours in design tokens; never hard-code hex values in components.
- Every interactive control needs a visible focus state and a keyboard path.
- Prefer server-side filtering over shipping the whole dataset to the browser.

## Gotchas

- Vite and `tsconfig` must agree on path aliases, or imports work in the editor and fail at build time.
- A `useEffect` that sets state from a derived value causes an update loop.
- Chart libraries often ignore `prefers-reduced-motion`; disable animation explicitly.

## Next steps

- Add a table view for screen readers.
- Profile the first render with 5k points.

cards.title: Harbor Infra
cards.body:
# Harbor Infra

Synthetic deployment notes for the Engramkeep demo store.

## Decisions

- Build multi-architecture images in CI with `docker buildx`.
- Keep Terraform state in a remote backend with locking enabled.
- Pin every image tag to a digest in production.
- Run one deployment at a time; the pipeline holds the lock.

## Gotchas

- An `exec format error` on an ARM machine usually means the image was built for the wrong platform.
- Terraform state locks outlive crashed CI runs; confirm no apply is active before forcing an unlock.
- `latest` tags make rollbacks ambiguous; deploy digests instead.

## Next steps

- Add a smoke test after deploy.
- Document the rollback procedure.

cards.title: Prairie ML
cards.body:
# Prairie ML

Synthetic experiment-tracking notes for the Engramkeep demo store.

## Decisions

- Record the dataset hash, git commit, and random seed with every run.
- Store metrics in SQLite for local runs and export CSV for sharing.
- Keep training scripts in the repository; keep datasets and checkpoints outside it.
- Compare runs with the same seed before drawing conclusions.

## Gotchas

- Parallel workers writing metrics to one SQLite file trigger `database is locked`; batch writes in the parent process.
- Sorting a dict of floats for a report hides ties; sort by metric and name.
- A notebook is not a reproducible experiment until it runs top-to-bottom in a clean environment.

## Next steps

- Add a `--dry-run` mode that validates paths and config only.
- Publish a small synthetic dataset with the examples.
